newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 323 bln lire of Italy BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 323 bln lire of Italy BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 111 billion lire worth of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTPs) and 212 billion lire worth of five-year BTPs against an Italian Treasury offer of 550 billion lire worth and 500 billion lire respectively.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 6.874 trillion lire at an open auction for a first tranche of the January 1, 2000 paper, against 5.5 trillion on offer, and bids for 5.992 trillion lire worth of a first tranche of the January 1, 2002 BTPs against an offer of 5.0 trillion.
The three-year BTP gross yield was 6.10 percent and 6.54 percent for the 5-year paper. Assigned prices were 99.95 and 99.20 respectively.
